svg.aria-label: The four moving parts of a GenAI system, each with a version and the route a change takes. Model: a pinned, dated version, never a latest alias; the vendor retires or updates it; the change is material: re-tier, full suite, MRM, the signers. Prompt: major.minor, changed by a pull request; the reviewer decides which: a major version is material, a minor version takes peer review and the suite still runs. Sources: an index build and each page version, changed by a page owner; the suite re-runs with expected answers checked and permissions re-tested. Vendor: the contract and assessment; new terms or a sub-processor bring a contract re-check, and a new provider is material. Every change: a new version, the suite before release, a line in the release record and a rollback to the last approved version.
